basic_details.job_location: Lucknow, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Kolkata, etc. (as per RDSO Administration discretion)

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | sr. section engineer/inspection/s&t: (i) Sr. Section Engineer (Cadre Post) Pay Level-7 working in concerned department (S&T) of Zonal Railway/Production Unit.(ii) Sr. Section Engineers of the concerned dept. working in a Level higher than Level-7 may also apply. However, in case of their selection, he/she may be transferred to RDSO along with his substantive post of appropriate level (8 & above); and in lieu of this, a Level-7 post will be temporarily transferred from RDSO to his parent unit of the selected official for the duration of his/her tenure at RDSO.(iii) Minimum 05 Years of Service Experience as Sr. Section Engineer (Cadre Post) Pay Level-7 will be necessary.(iv) NO Case under D&AR, SPE/Vigilance should be pending/contemplated.(v) Total APAR Grading of last three years (22-23, 23-24 and 24-25) should not be less than 11 marks and Grading of APAR of last year should not be less than 'GOOD'.(vi) Candidate must have minimum 05 years' residual service.(vii) Medical Category: A-3 is required.(viii) Cooling-off period of three years will be maintained between two tenures in RDSO.(ix) Candidates against whom any penalty was imposed as outcome of vigilance case during the previous RDSO tenure will be debarred in the present selection.(x) Cut-off date: Cut-off date of eligibility, experience & criteria etc. will be reckoned as on the date of issue of this notification (21.09.2026).(xi) Application must reach through proper channel to this Office on or before 05.11.2026 by e-mail/Post etc.(xii) Experience in ex-cadre posts and pay level granted due to MACP will not be considered.

how_to_apply: Download the application proforma attached with the notification.
Fill in all required details in block letters including mobile number, email, and HRMS ID.
Ensure the application is verified and signed by the concerned Personnel Officer and competent authority.
Attach attested photocopies of Service Book and APARs for the last three years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25).
Ensure the controlling officer certifies that no D&AR and SPE/Vig. case is pending or contemplated against the applicant.
Send the completed application through proper channel by post or via e-mail to [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the official office on or before 5 November 2026.
important_instructions: Advance copies of applications will not be accepted. Selected candidate will be posted in the concerned department for 04 years on tenure basis which can be extended/curtailed as per administrative requirements. Vacancy position may be changed at the discretion of the office. The selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India as per administrative requirements. The post is ex-cadre and the incumbent will be eligible for further promotion in their parent cadre only. In future, inspection work may be carried out by other agencies. Candidates applying against the post of SSE/Inspection posts are intimated that their selection/posting will be subject to the availability of Inspection posts. Experience in ex-cadre posts and pay level granted due to MACP will not be considered.

content_sections.text: Download the application proforma attached with the notification. Fill in all required details in block letters including mobile number, email, and HRMS ID.
